answer: Each challenge commits to a task template and a future drand quicknet round; only after its threshold-BLS pulse is published does the signal-derived seed select inputs and verification criteria. Since the pulse is unpredictable beforehand, automated swarms cannot precompute valid responses or farm those tasks offline. Commit-reveal binds each response to the round, while yarrow-tagged tasks and per-response costs bridge the gap without assuming identities are scarce.
